name: latency-cost
title: Latency and cost
summary: Score the nearest-rank p95 of useful milliseconds per correctly answered business unit, with correctness and workload guards.
goal: Lower the p95 useful latency for correct answers without losing correctness, output equivalence or workload coverage.
targetGuidance: Set the bar a few percent below the measured baseline; repeat the measurement to see noise before accepting a small win.

guardDetails.completeness: Every manifest case appears exactly once.
guardDetails.success: Every row is marked correct; an incorrect row is a rejected result, not a faster one.
guardDetails.equivalence: Every row's output matches the manifest's expected output.
guardDetails.load: The workload declares the request count and cache condition.

data.label: SAMPLE FIXTURE — replace with real workload cases and measured outputs

knownBad.reason: Same answers, slower p95; the score must rise.
The output does not match the expected answer even though the row claims correctness.
A row marked incorrect cannot be scored as a fast correct unit.

repeats.why: The adapter is deterministic; real candidate runs should be repeated to measure noise.

notes: For a real run, replace the sample manifest and fixtures. Measure warm and cold paths separately. A microbenchmark win is not an end-to-end win until the user path is also checked.
